entities.name: Hoggoth
entities.description: A power invoked by name in an oath used to deny a spell.

entities.name: Spider-Man
entities.description: A hero whom none of the Sinister Six could defeat alone.

entities.name: Sinister Six
entities.description: A group of six foes of Spider-Man who believe that together they would be unstoppable.

entities.name: Borg
entities.description: A collective described by a speaker who calls herself the beginning, the end and the one who is many.

relations.note: The Sinister Six band together to defeat Spider-Man.
relations.quote: None of them could defeat Spider-Man alone.
